name: 23517 · Norfolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23517 (Norfolk) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23517 (Norfolk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23517 (Norfolk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
